transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have our routine pre-publication check-in coming up, and I'd like to sort out the status on 'Glass Harbor' before we finalize the catalog. As it stands, the catalog draft lists the film at 94 minutes with its premiere status still marked for confirmation. Given that the national competition requires both a national premiere and a runtime of 90 minutes or under, we need to clarify a couple of things. Could the submissions team confirm the premiere status, and could technical screening verify the runtime on the approved master? That will help me determine whether Glass Harbor belongs in the national competition or should be placed in the panorama program instead.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I checked the national festival database yesterday and confirmed that 'Glass Harbor' already had a public screening at the Coastline Film Week in this country. I recorded the result in my local review notes, but the database export feeding Mara's catalog review has not refreshed, so that information hasn't appeared in the catalog system yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed ingest quality control this morning and confirmed that the filmmaker's approved festival cut is an 88-minute DCP, not the 94 minutes listed in the catalog draft. The QC report is waiting in the technical queue and hasn't yet been attached to the programming record.
transcript.speaker: A3
